about_the_game:
Let the story unfold, reveal all the secrets, and take on the simple but brain-twisting puzzles!

In Fortune Fragments, you run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by reading their souls! Sink in the unique blend of Visual Novel roleplaying and hex-tile based rune building set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle.

  • Solve challenging hex tile spatial puzzles

  • Get to know the large cast of characters and help them solve their problems

  • Follow branching storylines, where your choices directly affect the fates of your clients

  • Play a unique rune-building mechanic 

  • Unravel the tangled mysteries brewing in Clearcastle

Having just opened up your Foreteller's shop, you must do your sacred duty and solve the troubles of your wayward customers. Do you console them or give them a rude awakening? Encourage their dreams or make their fears come true? Use their soul stones and your own magical rune fragments to reveal their fate and choose their future actions!

Puzzling Rune Magic

Use your fortune fragments to create magical runes on your board. These runes conduct your power to see into the future, but you have a limited number of turns and redraws to achieve your goals.

As you use your powers, you’ll unlock more powerful runes and new fragments you can use!

The customers' souls form different obstacles for you. Sometimes it’s about gathering energy from the board aspects, sometimes it is about revealing things hidden in the darkness.

There can also be sides and aspects that aren’t visible at first glance. You may need to try again, as you learn how the board will react to your actions.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04, Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 | Intel i5 Skylake
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 | AMD RX 570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics API: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan (Nvidia or AMD)
